title: Automatic issue reporting from Nano, offline and sandboxes (user's GitHub account, bot fallback)
pr_body:
## Automatic issue reporting (#187)

Simulators file a scrubbed GitHub issue when something Vyomi owns breaks: under the user's own GitHub account if they consented, otherwise by the Vyomi bot anonymously. The conformance runner already fixes `user-reported` issues first and closes them when a release ships (section 6 was done on main; no second path was built).

### Built here
- `core/issue_report.py`: scrubber (emails, IPs, secrets/keys/tokens/JWTs/PEM, account/project/subscription ids, URL query, paths; resource names hashed), classifier (5xx, unhandled exceptions, failed console actions, JS errors; never tier locks, user 4xx or cancelled), fingerprint, `IssueReporter` (modes, per-process dedupe, persisted retry queue, `VYOMI_NO_TELEMETRY=1` sends nothing).
- Offline + sandboxes: outermost ASGI `IssueReportMiddleware` (5xx + unhandled exceptions, response never altered), `routes/issue_reporting.py` (`GET/PUT /api/issue-reporting`, `POST /api/issue-reporting/report` for console errors), mode synced from the portal account on licence refresh and pushed back on change.
- Consoles: one shared `issue-reporter.js` (`static/` and `wasm/`, byte-identical) in the AWS/GCP/Azure consoles: JS errors, unhandled rejections, failed (5xx) console actions, the one-time consent dialog with the approved copy ("Not now" as prominent as "Yes"), and a small "Issue reporting" link opening the settings panel.
- Nano: `wasm/sw.js` reports unhandled SW exceptions and 5xx engine responses and forwards `/api/issues/*` to the portal with the session; `wasm/nano-boot.js` reports in-browser engine (Pyodide) dispatch exceptions.
- Portal PR (not merged): https://github.com/vyomi-cloud/portal/pull/18 (endpoint, settings, GitHub App link, rate limits, audit table, enterprise triage store, named/anonymous stats, vendored Nano bundle).

### Configure
- Appliance: `VYOMI_NO_TELEMETRY=1` disables everything; `VYOMI_ISSUE_REPORT_URL` overrides the portal URL; `VYOMI_SURFACE=sandbox` (or Codespaces) tags the surface.
- Portal: `VYOMI_ISSUES_BOT_TOKEN` (required for any filing), optionally the GitHub App (`VYOMI_ISSUES_APP_CLIENT_ID/SECRET`). Without the App everything runs in bot mode.

### A person must still
- Create the Vyomi GitHub App (Issues read/write, only on vyomi-cloud/appliance) and set the portal secrets; create the bot token.
- Review and merge the portal PR after local verification (it is a production deploy).
- Run the two Playwright UI suites (not run in the agent environment: no browser).

### Tests (run here)
- `tests/conformance/test_issue_report_core.py`: 43 checks (scrubber on 14 real-shaped payloads, classifier, routing, fingerprint, modes, dedupe, queue, no-telemetry).
- `tests/conformance/test_issue_report_middleware.py`: real FastAPI app and the real `server.app`: forced 5xx files exactly one scrubbed report, repeat adds none, tier 403/4xx/no-telemetry send nothing, settings + account sync.
- `tests/conformance/test_issue_reporter_js.mjs` (same fixtures in JS, offline vs Nano transports) and `tests/conformance/test_nano_sw_issue_reporting.mjs` (real `wasm/sw.js`: one scrubbed report per forced exception, portal forwarding).
- Portal: `pytest tests/test_issue_reports.py` 16 passed (named authors as user, declined has no username anywhere, token failure falls back to bot, +1 wording, rate limits, enterprise triage, stats separate named/anonymous).
- Not run: `wasm/ui-tests/validate-issue-reporting.mjs` (offline + Nano consent dialog shown once, choice saved, Settings toggle). Registered in `suites.json` as `offline-ui-issue-reporting` / `nano-ui-issue-reporting`.
- Known gap: the SDK relay worker (`wasm/relay/*`) does not report yet; `tests/test_api_parity_contracts.py` fails identically on main (needs a live server).
